# Removing a duplicate stylesheet link can preserve the dependency and fix its order

multimessageview.xhtml retains messenger.css, which imports global.css and then variables.css. This patch removes a later direct global.css link, so it changes duplicate loading and cascade order rather than dropping the global stylesheet entirely. The header button focus rule consumes --focus-outline and its shared color chain. Review identifies the existing import. Check imported styles and variable consumers before removing or restoring a direct link. Computed focus appearance was not validated.

Scope: Multi-message header styling.
